response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with a strong focus on performance and architecture. However, his primary expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang, with limited demonstrated experience in C++, STL, industrial automation, or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure). His background does not align closely with the required C++-heavy, security-focused industrial automation role, though his problem-solving skills and secure development practices are evident.
strengths: Strong background in high-performance, low-latency systems (e.g., DLang at Dunnhumby)
Experience with secure development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to architect scalable systems (e.g., geo-data platform, event-driven architectures)
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++ and STL in the context of industrial automation or on-premises/cloud solutions
No clear exposure to IEC 62443 or industrial cybersecurity standards
Lacks hands-on experience with message brokers, MQTT, or industrial protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA)
